description: A signed integer overflow in the stride computation of the scaletempo audio filter results in a heap buffer overflow.
technical_details: The stride size computation in the scaletempo filter uses signed integer arithmetic that can overflow, producing an incorrect (likely negative or wrapped) stride value. This miscomputed stride is then used for buffer indexing or allocation, leading to out-of-bounds heap access.
title: Integer overflow in scaletempo audio filter leading to heap buffer overflow via signed integer overflow in stride computation
